# Surname substitution positions and neighbors

Captured on 2026-11-13 UTC in a fresh 30-day campaign scratch org, deleted
and verified after capture. See `RUN-FACTS.txt` for timestamps, input hashes,
frozen prediction hashes, capture design and counts.

`org.tsv` has 512 observations: 64 methods at APIs 62.0 and 67.0, anonymous
and named test routes, each repeated twice. Every method's eight observations
agree exactly. FindDuplicates and DML agree on every entry. Predictions were
frozen at the starting head before scratch creation or native observations.
The driver rejects log truncation, incomplete frames and class API mismatches.

Panel J has 480 directed inputs: first, middle and final substitutions,
lengths four through eight, same-row, vertical and diagonal neighbors plus
far-key controls, Contact and Lead, both directions. Panel K adds 144
corroboration controls. Exact positive and unrelated negative sentinels are
asserted within every method. All inputs and sentinels run through both Find
and DML. No new confidence residuals are allowed.

The four-letter cross-row grade bucket starts at captured smaller sum 34;
the rows do not locate the boundary between the lower and upper buckets.
Bottom-row six-column four-letter membership has a captured miss at smaller
sum 32 and a hit at 40. Six-letter grades are 97 at smaller sums 38 and 42,
and 98 at 50. Top-row nine-column seven-letter controls miss at 41 and match
at 51 and 57. The gaps retain the lower bucket. Other far-key geometries and
three-letter nonterminal/cross-row supplemental substitutions retain the
inherited gate. These rows do not establish a universal native distance formula.
